question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The monk meditated beneath the ancient __**corbel**__ protruding from the chapel wall.

options.text: The corbel cracked under the weight of the vaulted stone.
The corbel was adorned with grotesques typical of Gothic style.
The scholar explained the political corbel in Machiavellian strategy.
The mason restored the damaged stone corbel last year.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"corbel"** in its architectural sense refers to a structural piece of stone, wood, or metal jutting out from a wall to carry a superincumbent weight. (कॉर्बल – दीवार से निकला हुआ सहायक हिस्सा, जो किसी वजन को सहारा देता है।)

 
 
• **Example:** The corbel supported the overhanging balcony of the old castle.
 
 
 
• In the context of Option 3, **"corbel"** is used metaphorically to describe a political strategy or concept. This is the homonym of the architectural term. (कॉर्बल – रणनीति या अवधारणा के रूप में प्रतीकात्मक उपयोग।)
 
 
• **Example:** The scholar discussed the corbel of diplomacy in ancient treaties.
 
 
 
• The use of the word in Option 3 represents its homonym, as it is not referring to the architectural meaning but rather a metaphorical application.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The corbel cracked under the weight of the vaulted stone. (कॉर्बल – दीवार से निकला हुआ सहायक हिस्सा।)

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy stone structure caused the corbel to crack due to excess pressure.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The corbel was adorned with grotesques typical of Gothic style. (कॉर्बल – दीवार से निकला हुआ सहायक हिस्सा।)
 
 
• **Example:** The Gothic chapel featured corbels decorated with intricate carvings of mythical creatures.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The mason restored the damaged stone corbel last year. (कॉर्बल – दीवार से निकला हुआ सहायक हिस्सा।)
 
 
• **Example:** The restoration work ensured the corbel could support the upper structure again.
